Jobomschrijving

As part of the HR team, you will play a key role in supporting managers and employees on all operational and administrative HR matters. You will act as the first point of contact for Hard HR topics, ensuring compliance with local labour legislation, accuracy of HR data, and smooth execution of HR processes throughout the employee lifecycle.

This position offers an excellent opportunity for an HR professional who wants to further develop expertise in Belgian labour law, HR administration, payroll coordination, and HR operations.

Employee Lifecycle Management

• Manage and coordinate all administrative HR processes from onboarding to offboarding.
• Prepare employment contracts, contract amendments, and other employment-related documents.
• Follow up on employee movements, including promotions, transfers, changes in working time, and organizational changes.

Payroll & Compensation Administration

• Act as the main point of contact for payroll administration and collaborate closely with the payroll provider.
• Follow up on absences, leave requests, time registration, and benefits administration.
• Support compensation and benefits administration and related documentation.

Labor Law & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with Belgian labour legislation, collective labour agreements, and internal policies.
• Monitor legislative changes and support the implementation of required updates.
• Provide first-line guidance to managers and employees on contractual and administrative HR matters.

HR Operations & Data Management

• Maintain accurate employee data in HR systems (Workday and other HR tools).
• Ensure data quality, reporting accuracy, and compliance with GDPR requirements.
• Create and maintain HR procedures, policies, templates, and documentation.

Process Improvement

• Identify opportunities to improve HR processes and administrative efficiency.
• Support the digitalization and automation of HR activities.

Contribute to HR projects related to compliance, employee administration, and operational excellence.

• Master's degree, preferably in Human Resources, Business Administration, Payroll Administration or a related field
• Fluent in Dutch and French, both written and spoken; good command of English
• Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in an HR generalist, HR operations or payroll-related role
• Good knowledge of local legislation (knowledge of Luxembourg legislation is a plus)
• Good knowledge of Office tools (Outlook, Excel, Power point)
• Knowledge of Workday is a plus
• Strong communication and presentation skills
• Strong analytical skills
• Comfortable working with digital HR systems, tools and process automation
• Results oriented
• Good administrative and organizational skills
• Open-minded, autonomous, flexible and proactive
• Able to handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism

About the Role
Oliver James is partnering with a leading enterprise organization migrating its core legacy systems from Adabas (Mainframe) to PostgreSQL.

We are seeking a Data Functional Analyst to bridge the gap between legacy business logic and modern database architecture. Working directly alongside Data Engineers and DBAs, you will define data mappings and ensure a seamless, high-integrity migration.
Key Responsibilities
• Legacy Data Analysis & Mapping: Deep-dive into Mainframe data structures and define accurate functional target mappings to PostgreSQL relational schemaq.
• Technical & Functional Guidance: Act as the primary functional advisor for Data Engineers and DBAs, writing clear functional specifications to guide ETL/ELT pipeline development and schema design.
• Data Quality & Reconciliation: Design data validation strategies, define test scenarios, and execute cross-database reconciliation checks (Mainframe legacy vs. PostgreSQL) to guarantee 100% data integrity and consistency.
• Data Lineage & Documentation: Maintain comprehensive data dictionaries, mapping rulebooks, and lineage documentation throughout the migration lifecycle.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the functional point of contact for resolving legacy data ambiguities and translating complex business rules for the technical delivery team.
Requirements & Qualifications
• Functional Data Expertise: 3 years of experience as a Data Functional Analyst, Business Data Analyst, or Data Consultant on large-scale data transformation projects.
• Database & SQL Skills: Strong, mandatory expertise in PostgreSQL and advanced proficiency in SQL and relational data modelling concepts.
• Mainframe Experience: Solid functional understanding of Mainframe database environments (knowledge of Adabas is nice to have, but not mandatory).
• Migration Track Record: Hands-on experience working on complex legacy-to-relational data migration projects.
• Language Skills:
• Fluent English (written and spoken).
• Professional fluency in French and/or Dutch (essential for local team and business stakeholder collaboration).
• Communication & Mindset: Excellent analytical skills, rigorous attention to detail, and the ability to articulate complex functional rules clearly to technical teams.

During approximately the first year, you will work in a two-shift system (early and late shifts) while completing your training. After your training period, you must be willing to work night shifts as part of the regular production schedule.

• Are motivated to learn and develop through practical training in the workplace.	
• Have a hands-on mentality and enjoy solving technical problems.	
• Work accurately and pay attention to safety.	
• Enjoy working in a team and communicate well with colleagues.	
• Have a communicative knowledge of Dutch or English.
